conflicts_examined.issue: SCR556 calls V555 route identity opaque producer semantics while M3 must prove exact seven-field participant resolution.
conflicts_examined.resolution: Opacity forbids V556 reconstruction/reownership, not exact producer-identity verification. V556 may deterministically dereference and compare the exact producer-owned tuple and immutable seal while deriving no replacement semantics from its fields.

conflicts_examined.issue: V555 has internal SOURCE->MEDIATION_LOCUS->RECEIVER order while V556 has participant ordinals/order.
conflicts_examined.resolution: They are separate order domains: V555 order is internal to one atomic route; V556 order is among whole route participants under exact higher-order rule authority. Neither can rewrite the other.

conflicts_examined.issue: M2 B1 is required to prove positive V555 structural use/replay but SCR555 route identity has exactly seven fields.
conflicts_examined.resolution: M2 dispositively fixed B1 as a permission/reference/replay boundary with zero route multiplicity and not an eighth route identity field. M3 preserves that exact holding.

conflicts_examined.issue: Inherited V554 F2 is interpretation-critical but must not leak into V556 participant semantics.
conflicts_examined.resolution: F2 remains V554-owned exact-reference-only context through V555. M3 allows exact replay/reference reachability where required but forbids F2 as a V555 route-identity member or V556-authored satisfaction.

conflicts_examined.issue: SCR556 permits same-route reuse when exact rule authorizes it while positive V556 meaning requires at least two distinct canonical routes.
conflicts_examined.resolution: Same-route reuse changes participant occurrence multiplicity only. It never creates a new V555 identity and cannot by itself satisfy the positive distinct-route floor of two.

conflicts_examined.issue: Exact route references may be represented by locators/hashes, creating risk that repository identity replaces producer identity.
conflicts_examined.resolution: Locators are allowed only as nonsemantic exact verifiable addresses. Deterministic dereference must reproduce the exact V555 tuple and authority/reference closure; tuple mismatch or failed closure yields fail-closed participant resolution.

conflicts_examined.issue: Shared source/provenance/context could be mistaken for V556 interaction or composition authority.
conflicts_examined.resolution: SCR555 and SCR556 agree: provenance/shared endpoint/time/geography/stratum/storage/co-resolution never establishes relation or composition. Cross-source composition remains NONE_BY_DEFAULT absent exact operation-specific positive authority.

conflicts_examined.issue: ROUTE_CANDIDATE_AUTHORIZED could be mistaken for V556 SUPPORTED or V557 publication permission.
conflicts_examined.resolution: The V555 state is participant eligibility only. V556 SUPPORTED requires exact higher-order rule evaluation, and V557 publication remains independently governed.

conflicts_examined.issue: M2 semantic branch now has a later administrative reassignment commit.
conflicts_examined.resolution: The reassignment order explicitly excludes its administrative commit from the accepted M2 semantic package. Repository compare proves semantic head 92128619122886d0ced877a29b42fdb453765246 is followed by exactly one commit adding only 00_NEW_ROLE_AND_TASK.md. M3 pins the accepted semantic head and exact result/contract blobs.

conflicts_examined.issue: M2 carries a staleness guard if M1 materially changes SCR554.
conflicts_examined.resolution: Accepted M1 token M1_ACCEPTED__SCR553_SCR554_SEAM_CLOSED pins the same SCR554 head b5d745ac70c833324c8be0addf6c08ad72372263 used by M2, reports harmonization_required=false, and stage_branches_merged_or_rebased=false.

conflicts_examined.issue: Non-dispositive M3 preflight contains useful eligibility/reference findings but cannot close final M3.
conflicts_examined.resolution: Preflight was consumed only because it finitely returned M3_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE. Every adopted holding was independently checked against accepted SCR555/M2/SCR556 authority; preflight supplied no final acceptance authority.
